checklist: If ___ had been ___, would have reached
items.model_en: Nine records reached the customer with an empty contract ID and nobody warned them. The warning never fired for the records that mattered, because nobody had marked the field as required. Two fields had carried the same number for months, so whichever one the report picked looked correct on its own. It only surfaced when the customer opened the renewal. If the field had been required from the start, no empty contract ID would have reached a customer.
items.coach_bn: ক্ষতি → কারণ → কেন লুকিয়ে ছিল → কখন ধরা পড়ল → প্রতিকার। পাঁচ ধাপেই একটা ইনসিডেন্ট রিপোর্ট শেষ।
